*Last updated: 14 July 2026*

AVT Consulting is run by Alexander van Twisk, a biostatistician based in Pretoria, South Africa. This notice explains what information this website collects and how it is used, in line with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

## Website analytics

This site uses Google Analytics 4 to understand how it is used: which pages are visited, roughly where visitors come from, and what kind of device and browser they use. Google Analytics sets cookies and collects usage identifiers for this purpose, and Google may process this data on servers outside South Africa.

I only ever look at this data in aggregate, to see what's useful on the site and what isn't. It is not used to identify you, and it is never sold or shared.

If you'd rather not be counted, you can block cookies in your browser settings or install Google's [Analytics opt-out browser add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).

## Contact form and email

When you use the contact form, your submission (name, email address, and whatever you tell me about your project) is processed by [Formspree](https://formspree.io/legal/privacy-policy/) and delivered to my email. If you email me directly, the same applies without the Formspree step.

This information is used only to respond to you and, if we work together, to provide the consulting you've asked for. It is never added to a mailing list, shared, or sold.

## Client and research data

Data shared with me during a consulting engagement is handled under the confidentiality terms we agree at the start of the project: stored securely, never shared, handled in line with POPIA and the conditions of your ethics approval, and deleted after the project closes if you wish. See the [FAQ on the Services page](services.qmd) for more.

## Your rights

Under POPIA you can ask what personal information I hold about you, and ask for it to be corrected or deleted. Just [email me](mailto:vantwiska@gmail.com) and I'll sort it out.

## Changes to this notice

If this notice changes, the updated version will be posted on this page.
